# `aitbc ipfs unpin`

Unpin content by CID on the local Kubo daemon or filesystem index.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ipfs unpin [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cid` | text | — | yes | The Cid. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ipfs unpin --cid <cid>
```
